question: Select from among the given options the most appropriate title for the passage.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Lack of Moral Values.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate title for the given passage is **"Lack of Moral Values".**
 
• This is because the entire passage is focused on discussing how the lack of moral values is responsible for the crisis prevalent in Indian society.
 
• The passage highlights how even the most powerful people in society have become accomplices of a corrupt culture, and how Indian society has not been able to lay down strong enough foundations for effective leadership.
 
• The passage also emphasizes that for any system of government to be successful, there needs to be a strong emphasis on moral values in society.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** option 2.**
